name: Mabel Harrow
source_profile: ● Mabel Harrow (NG) is a veteran stagecoach driver and superintendent of the company's eastern stations. Known for her practical judgment and remarkable familiarity with the frontier's roads, she is respected by merchants, teamsters, and even certain outlaw bands. She frequently clashes with company executives over dangerous schedules and inadequate protection for drivers.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 41 (source excerpt; may be partial)
